meta.title: Revenue Engineering Portfolio
meta.description: I build the revenue engine behind early-stage startups. Turning ambiguous startup problems into repeatable systems through evidence-based execution.

hero.headline: I build the revenue engine behind early-stage startups.

thesis.headline: I work where strategy meets execution.
thesis.bodyBefore: Growth isn't magic; it's an engineering discipline. I specialize in dropping into ambiguous, unstructured environments—messy ICP definitions, leaky pipelines, disconnected tech stacks—and building the architectural scaffolding required to scale. It's about creating
thesis.bodyAfter: that transforms visionary ideas into tactical, measurable daily operations.

founding.headline: Building the first repeatable sales motion.

items.title: Start with the customer
items.body: Systems serve the user, not the architect. Every internal process must ultimately reduce friction for the end client.

items.title: Bias toward 0 → 1
items.body: Imperfect action beats perfect planning. Launch the v1, gather data, iterate aggressively.

items.title: Automate the repetitive
items.body: Human capital is too expensive for rote tasks. If it happens three times, build a system or write a script.

meta.title: About
meta.description: Investment-trained operator. Most people wait for the system to exist — I build it when it doesn't.

hero.lineOne: Most people wait for the system to exist.
hero.lineTwo: I build it when it doesn't.

philosophy.headline: Investment-trained operator.
philosophy.body: Grounded in rigorous financial modeling and empirical data analysis. I approach revenue growth not as an art, but as an engineering discipline of capital allocation, compounding returns, and systemic optimization.
philosophy.imageAlt: Macro photograph of a precisely engineered brushed steel mechanism with deep directional shadows.

items.title: Head of Revenue Engineering
items.body: Architecting end-to-end go-to-market systems, deploying unified data models in SQL, and leveraging quantitative analysis to identify scale inefficiencies across enterprise sales motions.

items.title: Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations
items.body: Designed forecasting models in R and Excel. Overhauled compensation structures based on cohort survival analysis and marginal CAC metrics.

items.title: Investment Analyst
items.body: Conducted rigorous empirical research using Stata and Excel. Evaluated operational efficiency of portfolio companies, directly translating financial principles into actionable operational playbooks.

items.title: Data Science Associate
items.body: Built initial foundation in SQL and R. Spearheaded automated reporting pipelines, eliminating weekly manual reporting overhead by 90%.

hero.headline: A hands-on practice for founders who need traction, not theory.
hero.body: Built on a proprietary Revenue Engineering framework, this is execution-biased advisory designed to architect scalable growth engines and definitive market positioning.

tiers.title:
GTM Launch &
Partnership Sprint
tiers.body: A 6-week intensive designed to unblock stalled revenue channels. We audit your existing stack, redefine ideal customer profiles (ICP), and launch a targeted outreach system with measurable ROI.

tiers.label: Tier 02
tiers.title:
Brand & Narrative
Rebuild
tiers.body: Transform technical features into compelling market narratives. This engagement builds a cohesive positioning framework, pitch deck overhaul, and content architecture that commands authority.

tiers.label: Tier 03
tiers.title:
Fractional
GTM / BD
tiers.body: Ongoing executive partnership for post-Series A startups. Acting as an embedded Head of Growth or BD, steering pipeline generation, hiring the initial sales team, and closing early strategic accounts.
